topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer therapies and their mechanisms of action.

topics.label: Conventional Modalities and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine standard treatment modalities including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapies along with their systemic toxicities and efflux-mediated resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Vulnerabilities and Checkpoint Defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe strategies designed to exploit tumor-specific biological vulnerabilities, including hormone dependencies, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction, Kinase Inhibitors, and Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the therapeutic targeting of hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the molecular mechanisms that drive drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Targeted Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the development and mechanisms of therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor surface antigens.

topics.label: Immune Surveillance and Checkpoint Blockade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore anti-tumor immunity, neoantigen recognition, and the reactivation of exhausted T cells using immune checkpoint inhibitors.

topics.label: Bispecific Engagers and Engineered Cellular Immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss advanced immunotherapies that redirect or genetically reprogram T cells to target cancer cells.

topics.label: Challenges, Historical Progress, and Future Outlook
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the systemic challenges, historical improvements in patient survival, and emerging directions in cancer management.
